args.prompt: Two frames of the same RimWorld colony at midday, same camera, taken seconds apart. The FIRST was captured under Clear weather, the SECOND under Rain. Confirm all of: (a) the second frame is noticeably darker and less saturated than the first; (b) the second frame shows rain — diagonal streaks or a wet sheen over the ground; (c) both frames show a normally lit map, not a black screen, a missing map, or an obviously broken render.
args.expect: second frame is darker, desaturated, and visibly raining
